narrative.overview: Lumina LMS pairs academic rigor and administrative durability with contemporary software ergonomics.
keyCharacteristics: Disciplined slate-navy primary foundation with purposeful status accents.
Structured card and table containers with subtle borders and micro-shadows.
High visual scannability optimized for high-density checkout and inventory flows.

rules.name: The Status Purpose Rule
rules.body: Status colors are reserved exclusively for operational state.

rules.name: The Crisp Boundary Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface or card container must carry a subtle border.

dos: Do maintain tabular numerals for ISBNs, barcode scans, counts, and financial amounts.
Do preserve 12px outer radius for primary card containers and 8px for controls.
donts: Don't use decorative gradients or ungrounded heavy shadows behind text.
Don't mix multiple sans-serif fonts; preserve Manrope consistently.
